curated-fs-oswald-gf-antic: Tall, tight, and sure of itself. Antic keeps a sans body open-mouthed and drawn with one nib, so long paragraphs under Oswald move along without any fuss.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-ar-one-sans: Oswald packs its letters into tightly knit, confident rows. AR One Sans lifts its brush-like ends away before curves close, giving that dense heading a lighter sans companion beneath.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-chathura: Chathura reads compressed and quick, like thin steel rod bent into letters. Oswald above it is just as tight but strong and display-minded, so the two feel like related cuts of one metal.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-harmattan: Oswald leads with confident, tightly knit rows, say, for a bakery badge logo. Harmattan's sans strokes have no thick-thin shift, so if the heading shrinks, they would take over the page.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-rationale: Contemporary in feel, Oswald stands tall and tight up top while Rationale tucks its sans letters close with tiny gaps (a school crest would take it well). Long paragraphs would feel crowded, as it isn't meant for them.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-share-tech-mono: Share Tech Mono reads like a typewriter, every letter cut from one gauge of tubing (a yoga studio logo might use it). Oswald's heading is confident and tightly knit, while the monospace body suits brief copy better than extended reading.
curated-fs-panchang-author: Author reads refined and dignified, with a slight swell on its bowls. Panchang is best at wide, open, steady display lines, while Author's measured weight does its finest work in a few lines of text.
curated-fs-panchang-bitter: Bitter brings a slab-serif body with a very large lowercase and see-through s shapes (handy for boat and marine work). Panchang is best at flat, unmodulated strokes with generous space, while Bitter does its best at grounded, sturdy text.
curated-fs-pencerio-gf-andada-pro: Ink-wet and formal. Pencerio's calligraphic hand is best at a tight, graceful word shape, while Andada Pro's serif arches thin gently off the stem and handle a few lines of text.
curated-fs-pencerio-gf-bona-nova-sc: Bona Nova SC reads refined, its small counters unclogged and its serif strokes gently shaded. Its best quality is a lightly textured softness that lets Pencerio's formal, closely fitted script stand apart above it.
